groups.name: modular
groups.description: Henge: which @ModularService versions this process embeds, and how it reaches the others.

groups.name: modular.services
groups.description: Per service, by name: modular.services.<name>.mode (embedded | internal-rest) and .url, overridable per version as modular.services.<name>.versions.<n>.mode / .url. Unrecognized keys or service names fail startup.

groups.name: modular.store
groups.description: The datastore for Henge's shared state: modular.store.type picks it, modular.store.<type>.* configures it.

groups.name: modular.leases
groups.description: Per lease, by name: modular.leases.<lease>.capacity, the cluster-wide capacity services share out with @RequiresLease, and modular.leases.<lease>.amount, what one node claims of it.

groups.name: modular.server
groups.description: The /_modular dispatch endpoint this process serves.

groups.name: modular.topology
groups.description: The topology endpoint and page this process can serve.

groups.name: modular.transport
groups.description: The internal-rest client and its shared secret.

properties.name: modular.serve
properties.description: name[@version] entries naming what this process hosts; every other discovered service defaults to internal-rest. Names that match no @ModularService fail startup.

properties.name: modular.remote-url-template
properties.description: URL for any internal-rest service without an explicit url, with {service} and {version} substituted, e.g. http://{service}.default.svc.cluster.local:8080. Other placeholders fail startup.

properties.name: modular.store.type
properties.description: Which datastore holds this process's shared state (leases, service advertisements): in-process, or the type of an adapter module on the classpath, e.g. redis. Setting it while also defining a SystemEphemeralDatastore bean fails startup.

properties.name: modular.store.redis.uri
properties.description: For modular.store.type=redis: a Lettuce URI such as redis://host:6379/0 (rediss:// for TLS, redis://:password@host for a password). Required.

properties.name: modular.transport.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Calls made at most per invocation, the first included; 1 turns retries off. Only a call that provably never ran (a failed connection, or a process that doesn't serve the service) is retried.

properties.name: modular.transport.retry.backoff
properties.description: Wait before each retry. A bare number is milliseconds; 0 retries at once.

properties.name: modular.transport.retry.on
properties.description: Which failures are retried: connect (the connection couldn't be made), not-served (the process doesn't serve that service version), or both.

properties.name: modular.advertise.url
properties.description: Base URL other processes reach this one's /_modular at, published in its service advertisements, e.g. http://10.0.0.7:8080. Must be absolute http(s). Unset: advertisements give no address.

properties.name: modular.topology.enabled
properties.description: Whether this process serves its topology (services, modes, routes, the dependency graph, advertisements and leases) as JSON at <modular.server.path-prefix>/topology and as a page at /topology/ui. Off by default: it lists every service's host. With modular.transport.secret set, the JSON requires it; the page asks for it.

properties.name: modular.server.enabled
properties.description: Whether this process serves /_modular at all (a non-web application never does).

properties.name: modular.server.path-prefix
properties.description: Path prefix of the dispatch endpoint, for both the server and the client side. Must start with '/' and not end with one.

properties.name: modular.transport.secret
properties.description: Optional shared secret, sent as the Modular-Internal-Secret header and required by the dispatcher; with Spring Security it becomes an authentication. Unset is supported: the network is the boundary.

properties.name: modular.transport.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connect timeout of internal-rest calls. A bare number is milliseconds; 0 means no timeout.

properties.name: modular.transport.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout of internal-rest calls. A bare number is milliseconds; 0 means no timeout.
